name: Peppercorn Beef with Crispy Potatoes

components.name: Peppercorn Beef & Sauce

ingredients.name: Lean rump or sirloin steak, sliced

steps: Slice and season steak. In a large hot pan, colour the steak quickly in batches without crowding; remove before it overcooks.
Soften the minced shallot and garlic in the pan. Stir in both peppercorns very briefly until fragrant.
Deglaze with a splash of stock, scrape the pan, then pour in the rest and simmer until slightly reduced.
Off the heat, whisk in yogurt and Worcestershire. Fold the steak and juices through the warm sauce without boiling the yogurt.

components.name: Crispy Potatoes
steps: Cut potatoes evenly and toss with oil, thyme, rosemary and seasoning. Roast at 200°C for approximately 25–30 minutes (or air-fry at 190°C for 18–20 minutes), shaking once.

components.name: Sautéed Kale
steps: Wilt the kale in the beef pan for 1–2 minutes, season and remove.
Pack beef and sauce, roasted potatoes and kale as separate components. Re-crisp potato in air fryer when eating.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; quantities, macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Needs a second appliance: the potatoes roast in the oven or air fryer.
Freezer: Source approves freezing; potato crunch will deteriorate.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
